scripts.local-build: sh -c 'if [ -f local.build.sh ]; then ./local.build.sh "$@"; else echo "local build yok"; fi' --
scripts.local-install: sh -c 'if [ -f local.install.sh ]; then ./local.install.sh "$@"; else echo "local build yok"; fi' --
scripts.reset: for dir in apps/*; do if [ -d "$dir/.git" ]; then (cd "$dir" && git reset --hard); fi; done; rm -rf snippets/*/icons
